verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a UI library's ecosystem, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party React CLI. Setup is delegated to third-party frameworks and build tools (Next.js, React Router, Vite, Parcel, Rsbuild), and the first-party tooling cited is an npm-installed Babel plugin, an ESLint plugin and browser DevTools, none of which is a CLI.
